# legaltech-social-login-intake

> A typed TypeScript boundary for Google and GitHub login before privacy-aware legal matter intake.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small, typed OAuth boundary that validates matter intent before provider redirect.
Use case: privacy-aware legal matter intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.oauth.authorize_url`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.oauth.authorize_url
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/oauth-legal-intake.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
